title: POPE NICHOLAS & THE MOORS OF SPAIN

sense.text:
“And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea”: when the Bible talks about a beast, it is talking about a race of men, and the sea is the peoples of the world. John is witnessing a nation of men rise up out of the peoples, multitudes and nations.

“Having seven heads and ten horns”: the seven heads are Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain, and the eighth is America. The ten horns are Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark and Ireland.

“And upon his heads the name of blasphemy”: blasphemy means wicked lies against God.

“The beast which I saw was like unto a leopard”: this is not the actual Greeks, but the beast that rises has the attributes the Greeks had. “His feet were as the feet of a bear”: it has elements of the Persian-Mede empire, of Cyrus and those rulers. “His mouth as the mouth of a lion”: it has elements of ancient Babylon.

“And the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority”: Satan gave this kingdom its power and great authority.

So when you read the history of the Greeks, of Persia and Media, and of Babylon, there are things in that history that are being fulfilled in these last days. Not everybody knows that.

“I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death”: the head that was wounded was Rome, wounded to death in 193 AD. Septimius Severus took the throne, and the Roman histories themselves call him Rome’s first African emperor, and say he founded a dynasty that gave Rome its first emperors from the Middle East. He did not keep God’s commandments; he kept all the tenets of Rome and persecuted the black Jews that were keeping God’s laws. The only difference was that he was the first black Caesar on that throne, and the rulers after him were black as well. The Dark Ages began there, not in the 400s as they tell you.

The wound went on with the Moors. Negro, Moor and blackamoor all meant black, and the name Moor was given to the successors of Muhammad, to pagans, to Christians and to Jews. They held North Africa before the Arabs, the south of Europe and the islands of the Mediterranean, and founded the empire of Morocco. Musa sent his general Tariq into Spain, and in 711 (some records say 713) he killed the Gothic king Roderic at the battle of Guadalete. The army was mainly Berbers, black men who predate the Arabs in North Africa and speak Afro-Asiatic tongues. The Visigoths were Esau, and most of their nobles were slaughtered, opening the way to Toledo.

Those Moors were the black Jews. The records of 1759 admit that the most considerable families of Judah and Benjamin settled in Sepharad, Spain, where the royal line of David was best preserved, and they call them African Jews. They took over Spain and Portugal and rebuilt them, dressed like lords and royalty, not swinging from trees. They did not force everybody under their religion; there were Christian, Jewish, pagan and Muslim Moors, and the white people still living there were ruled by them. Counting from Severus, we ruled Europe for over a thousand years.

“And his deadly wound was healed”: that is the Renaissance, which means rebirth. The white man came back into power. They took Rome, then Constantinople (Turkey) in 1453, then Spain, then Portugal next to it. The historians cannot give one date for the end of the Dark Ages, pointing to 1453, Columbus in 1492 and the Reformation in 1517, because they took us down systematically, in different lands at different times.

“All the world wondered after the beast”: how did this white man come back into authority again?

“And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast”: they worshipped Satan, who gave power unto the beast, and Rome came back in power: Rome, Constantinople, Spain and Portugal.

“Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?” Who is like unto this white man? They had power, and this white man started to conquer everything.

precepts.why:
Solomon said in his heart “concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.” Men are beasts.

So when Revelation 13 speaks of a beast rising out of the sea, it is speaking of a race of men, a nation of men, rising up.

The angel explains the waters: “The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.”

So when John stood “upon the sand of the sea” and saw the beast “rise up out of the sea”, he was witnessing a nation of men rise up out of the peoples of the world.

“After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard”: the leopard represents the Greeks. “Which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl”: four armies; the Greek military had four major splits. “The beast had also four heads”: four major generals, Ptolemy, Lysimachus, Cassander and Seleucus. “And dominion was given to it.”

So when Revelation 13 says the beast was “like unto a leopard”, it is not the actual Greeks, but the beast that rises in the last days has the similarities and attributes the Greeks had.

“And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear”: this is the Persian-Mede empire. “And it raised up itself on one side”: Persia raised itself up and became greater than the Medes.

“And it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it”: those three ribs were Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans, the nations Persia swallowed (Isaiah 45). “And they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh.”

So “his feet were as the feet of a bear” means this last beast carries elements of the Persian-Mede empire, of Cyrus and those rulers.

The three ribs in the bear’s mouth: “The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine”. The Sabeans are Somalia. “In chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee.”

And who is “thee”? Verse 1: “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus”. God raised up Cyrus the Persian to conquer those three nations and take over the world. Those are the three ribs of Daniel 7:5, and that is the bear whose feet the beast of Revelation 13 stands on.

“The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings”: this was the Babylonians. “I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked”: they put down Assyria.

“And it was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man’s heart was given to it”: great wisdom was given to Babylon.

So the beast of Revelation 13 had elements of Greece in its body, of Persia and Media in its feet, and of ancient Babylon in its mouth.

“The word of the Lord that came to Micah the Morasthite”. The root of Morasthite is Moor, meaning black. The old histories call Micah a prophet of the Moors, who prophesied in the days of Hezekiah and spoke to all the people of Judah, the Moors. They also record that Mazaroth, the ancient encampment of Israel in the days of Moses, was built by the Moors.

So the name Moor was put on our people, Judah and Israel. The Moors who wounded the head of Rome and ruled Spain and Portugal were the black Jews of the royal line of David, not Arabs.

sense.text:
“And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them”: Esau rejoiced over our downfall. “And make merry”: Merry Christmas. “And shall send gifts one to another”: we were the gifts. When Count Frederick von Hanau took a large part of Suriname from the Dutch West India Company, he also received an Angolan man as a gift. Our sons, our daughters, our mothers and fathers were the gifts.

“Because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth”: the two prophets are the kingdom of Judah and the kingdom of Israel, on this side of the world. We did not play with Esau.

This is the history of Christmas. Pope Nicholas V, in his bull granting the unknown world to the Portuguese and the Spaniards, ordered the Christians to reduce all infidels into slavery; if you were black and did not believe in white Jesus, you were a slave. In 1492 King John II of Portugal expelled the Jews to the island of St. Thomas, and from them came the black Portuguese, as they called them. When the black Jews were driven out of Spain into Portugal, their children were torn from their mothers’ arms and baptized by force. Children under three were given to Christians for a Christian education, which was code for being raised as slaves; those from three to ten were shipped to St. Thomas, and those from ten to fourteen were sold. Mothers ran behind the ships and perished. The parents were given the choice of baptism or slavery.

And they celebrate it. In the Netherlands Sinterklaas is dressed as Pope Nicholas, riding a white horse that flies, and his servant is Zwarte Piet, Black Pete, named from Peter, the black Jew who followed Christ, played in blackface. In Austria, Liechtenstein and Slovenia they turned Black Pete into Krampus, the monster who will take bad children away. In America, when Christmas became a federal holiday in 1870, he became the elves: small, smiling, forever working, never free. Rearrange the letters of Santa and you have Satan. It is all a mockery of our defeat.

precepts.why:
“I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.” The children taken from the black Jews were supposed to be the princes over Spain and Portugal, and they became servants to this white man.

The paintings in Europe’s museums are full of them: young black boys of thirteen and fourteen holding the umbrella, the mirror, the horse. Even the dress of the Europeans in those paintings is the dress of the Moors; they got that from us. People look at them and say, look at that cute little black boy. Now you know: those were the children snatched from their mothers and made slaves to European families. Separate the children from the parents and give them a limited education; that is how they dumbed us down.

“If thy people go out to battle against their enemy”: do not think we just lay down and let them put yokes of iron on our necks. We went to war against Esau. The paintings of the capture of Antioch and of Charlemagne’s siege show the Moors in their castles, castles we built, with the lion’s face and the six-pointed star on their shields, and Europe chopping them up. Their own books call the black soldiers the enemy, the irreconcilable enemy, and they knew it came from the Bible.

We lost because we were in the midst of sin and God took his spirit. Solomon prayed that if they “pray unto the Lord toward the city which thou hast chosen”, God would “maintain their cause.” We did not face Jerusalem and pray; we were mixed, Christian Moors, Jewish Moors, pagan Moors and Muslim Moors.

“If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near”: they carried us captive into various lands.

We are living in verse 47 right now: “Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent”, saying, “We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness”. It has to come out of all our mouths. The Lord is not listening to the holier-than-thou spirit that says, I have never done anything wrong.

“And pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen”: this is why we face Jerusalem. Then hear our prayer, Father, “and maintain their cause.”

“And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.” People have left the truth of the word of God to follow fables, and Christmas is a fable: a lie, a story told with symbolic meanings in it. The merry-making and the gifts of Revelation 11:10 are wrapped up in that fable.

“Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.” Christmas and all these things turn you from the truth.

That is why people online say it is not wrong to celebrate Christmas, it is in your heart, it is how you feel. All of that turns you from the truth of God. They may admit it is not his birthday and say we can make up another day, but it is always December 25th.

There is a winter holiday that Christ kept: “And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter. And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon’s porch.” The feast of dedication is the one celebrated in the winter.

And the new year is not in winter. Abib is the spring, when the young barley ears first appear, at the end of March or beginning of April. If you see Israelite groups keeping Passover in February, or June, or July, there is something wrong.

sense.text: “And they worshipped the beast”: they worshipped Rome, the white man. “Who is able to make war with him?” Meaning, who can conquer him?

“And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies”: when Rome came into power they spoke great things and blasphemies. The image of Christ the world worships was posed for by Cesare Borgia, the son of Pope Alexander. They taught that this white man died for the sins of everybody on the planet; that to be saved you must be water baptized, dumped in the water, and accept white Jesus; they made everything European and instituted Lent, Christmas, December 25th and the rest of what Christians keep. They forced us to be water baptized.

“And power was given unto him to continue forty and two months”: 350 years.

“And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them”: the white man made war with us at Rome’s behest, in our castles, and overcame us. They defeated us. “And power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.”
“And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him”: they worship this man as God or the Son of God, but the image is actually Cesare Borgia.

Verse 10 is a response to verse 7. “He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity”: they led millions of us into captivity. “He that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword”: millions of us they killed with the sword.

“Here is the patience and the faith of the saints”: we must patiently wait for Christ to execute this. We are not doing it on our own; we must be patient and have faith that it will come to pass.

“And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth”: this is America. “And he had two horns like a lamb”: the two horns are the Democrats and the Republicans. Like a lamb, because they say they are Christian, In God we trust on the dollar, a nation built on Judeo-Christian values. That is all a lie.

“And he spake as a dragon”: many of their laws and decrees were of Satan, a demon, a devil. They forbade us to read and write, separated the children from the parents (because the parents who came over were educated) and taught the children nothing, and made Jim Crow laws after emancipation.

“And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him”: the first beast is Rome, which came back in power, and America rose up out of those European nations to be the world superpower, with the same decrees and the same power, dominating everything.

“And causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed”: that is the Renaissance. You may say you do not worship Rome, but look at the dollar bill: annuit coeptis, novus ordo seclorum, Latin, the language of Rome. January is named for Janus, the Roman god of beginnings and doorways. The months of the year and the days of the week all come from Rome and its gods.

precepts.why:
God set the calendar Israel was to keep: “This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.” And verse 11 shows what holiday comes in that month: “it is the Lord’s passover.” So Passover comes in the first month.

The new year of the world, on the first of January, named after Janus, is Rome’s. Keeping it is part of how the earth is caused to worship the first beast.

“Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage”, and then the name of that first month: “This day came ye out in the month Abib.”

Abib means spring: the season when the young, tender barley ears first appear, around the end of March and the beginning of April, the time of the Passover and the firstfruits. So the first month of the year is the spring month, not January. Even the white woman with the video can read it: the biblical new year does not begin in January.

Daniel saw the same thing as Revelation 13:5: “And he shall speak great words against the most High”. The great words are what we just read: this white man died for the sins of everybody, you must be dumped in the water to be saved, Lent, Christmas, Mother’s Day, December 25th.

“And shall wear out the saints of the most High”: that is slavery, the same as Revelation 13:7, “to make war with the saints, and to overcome them.”

“And think to change times and laws”: they changed the times. They have daylight saving time, and they moved the beginning of the year from the spring to January.

Something else they changed. “Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years”.

“And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night”: the greater light is the sun and the lesser the moon. Notice the wording: two great lights. He did not make a quarter moon or half a light; he made a great light.

The nations, the Maya and many cultures, gather and celebrate the full moon. What they call the full moon is actually the new moon.

Moses blessed Joseph: “Blessed of the Lord be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath”. Joseph’s sons Ephraim and Manasseh dwell on the islands; that is the Puerto Ricans and the Cubans, among others. The precious things of heaven are the rain, and the deep that coucheth beneath is the riches beneath the waters.

“And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon”: there are things on those islands that only come out by moonlight, like the coquí frog. It is speaking of the moon at its peak, what they call the full moon today, which is actually the new moon.

sense.text:
“Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ”: the principles of the doctrine of Christ are the animal sacrifices. Principle means the beginning, and in the beginning we got forgiveness of sin through animal sacrifice. We are to leave it: “let us go on unto perfection”, because there was no perfection in animal sacrifice.

“Not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works”: repentance with animal sacrifice. “And of faith toward God,” ends with a comma, so he is continuing the list of what we have to leave. Stress the word leaving.

“Of the doctrine of baptisms”: we must leave the doctrine of baptisms, and that includes the water baptism of John the Baptist. John did not make it up; it came from the priests’ washings, and Christ never used water, because it was always symbolic and was to end. That is the blasphemy Rome put on us when it taught that you must be water baptized to be saved.

“And of laying on of hands”: what Aaron did over the goat. “And of resurrection of the dead”: the sin offering made for the dead. “And of eternal judgment.” Christ is the new high priest, and all the things the priests did, we have to leave.

“And this will we do, if God permit.” When you read Paul’s letters, they were still doing these things. It finally came to an end, with no ifs, ands or buts, in 70 AD, when Esau destroyed the temple, put the priests in slavery, and many of us fled into Africa. That ended the argument.

“For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened”, enlightened with Christ and the understanding, “and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost, and have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come”.

“If they shall fall away”: that was the fight. Some Israelites said we have to go back to animal sacrifice and water baptism. If you leave Christ and go back to that, it is impossible “to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.” They never believed. When brothers and sisters leave this truth and go back to white Jesus and water baptism, we cannot help them.

precepts.why: The old ordinances “stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.” The divers washings are the baptisms, and they were imposed only until the time of reformation. That is why Hebrews 6 says to leave the doctrine of baptisms.
Where did the washing come from? God gave it to the priests: “For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat”. This is where John the Baptist got it from.
What the washing symbolized: “Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil”. The water was a sign of putting away the evil of your doings.

“For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord God.” The water never took away iniquity.

John the Baptist did not make up water baptism. It came from the priests, and John was in the lineage of the priesthood; he was a Levite.

John said himself that he used water: “I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire”.

Not with water. Christ never used water, because water baptism was to end; it was always symbolic. So the doctrine of baptisms that Hebrews 6:2 tells us to leave includes John’s water baptism.

The laying on of hands: “And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat”. That is what we did.

Paul is saying that all the things the priests were doing, we have to leave, because Christ is the new high priest.

The resurrection of the dead: “he sent it to Jerusalem to offer a sin offering, doing therein very well and honestly, in that he was mindful of the resurrection”. This is how we thought we got the resurrection, through the offerings. That too is among the things Hebrews 6 says to leave behind.

sense.text:
“He made the moon also to serve in her season”: the moon serves the seasons, and the feasts of the Lord are seasonal. “For a declaration of times”: the high holy days and things of that nature.

“And a sign of the world”: the moon’s rotation and phases represent the stages the world is in. The full moon is when we were in our full power and full understanding. As it wanes and gets dark, that is us going into captivity, into full darkness. When it comes back to its fullness, that is us going back into our glory, back into the kingdom. The darkness has covered this whole world, and when you see the moon dark, that is what it represents.

“From the moon is the sign of feasts”: every feast starts at the new moon, when it is in its brightness, because that is how it was in the kingdom. God made two great lights.

“A light that decreaseth in her perfection”: that is when it starts phasing out.

“The month is called after her name”: the word month comes from the word moon. “Increasing wonderfully in her changing”: the phases of the moon.

“Being an instrument of the armies above, shining in the firmament of heaven”: the moon is an instrument of the armies of heaven that follow Christ, like a base for them.

precepts.why:
“Concerning the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations”: convocation means gatherings. The first holiday God lists is the sabbath: “Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest”. He says nothing of seasons for the sabbath, because it is all year round.

Then: “These are the feasts of the Lord, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.” What follows are seasonal holidays. “In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the Lord’s passover”, in the spring; the feast of unleavened bread on the fifteenth day; Pentecost, numbering “fifty days”; “In the seventh month, in the first day of the month”, “a memorial of blowing of trumpets”, which is the seventh new moon celebration; the day of atonement on the tenth day of the seventh month; and “The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles”.

That is the moon serving “in her season” for “a declaration of times”: the feasts are kept by the moon in their seasons.

“Arise, shine; for thy light is come”: arise means wake up, shine means teach, and the light is Christ, who said I am the light. “And the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.”

“For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people”: we are in the grossest of darkness. We have lost our heritage; we have lost everything.

So when you see the moon dark, that is what it represents: the darkness that covers the whole world. That is the moon as “a sign of the world.”

“And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.” This is Christ, who will judge and make war on this planet when he returns.

“And he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.” What are you arguing and fussing for? When you hear a negro say, we already know the name, it is Yahawashi, that is crap. Either the Bible is a lie or the negro from Harlem is a liar. Make your decision. “And his name is called The Word of God.”

“And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.” There are armies in heaven, and the moon is “an instrument of the armies above”.

sense.text: “God standeth in the congregation of the mighty”: we are the mighty. “He judgeth among the gods”: see that little g? That is us; that is who we are. Asaph, writing with the Holy Spirit upon him, is recording what we did wrong as the gods of the earth.

“How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked?” These are the sins we were guilty of. The law said not to deal with the women of other nations, and we said, look how good that one looks, I am going to deal with her (Genesis 6). We accepted the persons of the wicked, the other nations, and we were partial.

Now it tells us what we should have done: “Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy. Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.” We were not doing it. That is why the wickedness of man was continual, and why God had to bring the flood.

“They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness”: we walk in darkness, gross darkness, like the moon in its darkness.

“All the foundations of the earth are out of course”: everything is out of whack because of our sins. If the sabbath comes every seven days, how many days should be in a month? Twenty-eight. The seasons are out of whack; a winter lasts forever and you see snow in April and June. We have to wait for Christ to come back and set everything in order, and it will happen when he brings Israel back.
“I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.” This goes back to verse 1, and to the sons of God of Genesis 6:2.

“But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.” Our godhood has been taken from us. The flood came and we all died; we came back through Noah’s son Shem, and we still have not learned our lesson. Now we fall and die like the other nations.
“Arise, O God, judge the earth”: we are asking Christ to rise and judge the earth. “For thou shalt inherit all nations”: Christ will inherit all nations (Psalms 2).

precepts.why: Here is something out of course because of our sins: “And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.” Two great lights. The moon that waxes and wanes, that goes dark, is not how it was made; that is part of the foundations of the earth being out of course. Isaiah 30:26 shows how it will be when it is set right.

sense.text:
This is the kingdom. “Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun”. Does the sun have phases of transition? No. So in the kingdom the moon, which is a sign of the world, will not go back into darkness again. It is going to stay right.

“And the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days”: the sun we say is so bright is not bright at all next to what is coming.

“In the day that the Lord bindeth up the breach of his people”: when he gathers the twelve tribes of Israel back again, raising up the tabernacle of David that is fallen and closing up its breaches (Acts 15, Amos 9). “And healeth the stroke of their wound.”

precepts.why:
“Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.” Why the new moon? It is the beginning of the month, yes, but it is also to remind us of when we were in our glory.

In the time of Adam, before he fell, the moon did not phase. The phases started when Adam fell: the quarters, then the dark moon, then it comes back. When the new moon comes in its brightness, God says, celebrate me, because this is how it was in the beginning. “For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.”

And Isaiah 30:26 is the day it goes back to that brightness for good, when the moon shines as the sun.

sense.text: “Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name. And to this agree the words of the prophets”: the prophet Amos. Simeon is paraphrasing Amos 9, saying the same thing.

“After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down”: I am bringing back the twelve tribes of Israel. Right now it is still fallen; we are trying to gather ourselves together. This is the breach of Isaiah 30:26 being bound up.

“That the residue of men might seek after the Lord”: how will they seek after the Lord? In captivity, in slavery. They do not get a pass for all the evil they did.

“And all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called”: what do they call themselves? Jews and Christians. The word Jew comes from Judah, which means praise of God, so Amalek is saying they are the praise of God. Christian means anointed ones, so they call themselves God’s anointed. Really? A chain for you, and you, and you.

“Saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.”

precepts.why:
Simeon is quoting Amos: “In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof”. That is the same as Isaiah 30:26, the day the Lord binds up the breach of his people: when he gathers the twelve tribes of Israel back again. “And I will build it as in the days of old”: he will build us as in the days of old.

“That they may possess the remnant of Edom”: possess means own. We are going to own the remnant of Edom. “And of all the heathen, which are called by my name”: heathen means nations, and those called by his name are the ones who call themselves Jews and Christians. We are going to possess them.

“Saith the Lord that doeth this”: he is going to make sure it is done. Acts 15:17 does not contradict Amos 9:12; Amos just made it plain.

How will the residue of men seek after the Lord? “For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.” In captivity. There is no, we are equal with you, we are ruling with you.

They are going to learn God’s laws, his statutes and his commandments in slavery, and whoever does not want to follow them shall be put to death. People online say the door is open for everyone; they do not understand.

Another precept that the residue of men will seek after the Lord: “every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.” The feast of tabernacles is in the seventh month, on the fifteenth day, so we are going to have to teach that to the nations.

“And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.” There may be some rebellious heathen out there. No rain is judgment: famine, dearth, death. “And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague”.

That is how the residue of men seek after the Lord, and that is what “all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called” have coming.

sense.text: “When men began to multiply on the face of the earth”: nations began to form on the face of the earth, “and daughters were born unto them.”

“That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair”: the sons of God are not angels. This is us, before we were called Israel. “And they took them wives of all which they chose”: we started taking wives of the other nations, and there were laws against it. We already had the laws, and we broke them. That is how we judged unjustly (Psalms 82:2).

“And the Lord said, My spirit shall not always strive with man”: God is angry with man, and the man he is talking about is the sons of God. “Yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years”: he cut down our lifespan.
“When the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown”: our sons by them became mighty men, famous men.

“And God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.” We went in unto the daughters of men and had children with them, and our children turned into the devil, acting like the devil on the planet. That is why the flood came.

precepts.why: Who are the sons of God? “Thus saith the Lord, Israel is my son, even my firstborn”. Now we know who the sons of God are in Genesis 6:2. It is not talking about angels; it is talking about us.
“Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God”. We, the Israelites, are the ones called the sons of God.

“For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.” All creation is waiting for the manifestation of the sons of God, Israel. Before the flood we were called the sons of God, and in Genesis 6 those sons of God took the daughters of men.

The law against what the sons of God did: “Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son. For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.”

They will turn you away from following him. That is the judging unjustly of Psalms 82:2.

“Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them”: we were forbidden to make marriages with the other nations. And what happens? “They shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land”.

Look at the snares and traps today. The black woman who no longer thought she looked good as a black woman and cut up her face. The black women who said the white man is better than the black man and were put to death by them; the brother who spoke evil of black women and was stabbed to death by a white woman, who walked free. Sherrone Moore, with a white woman at home, lost his Michigan contract, over twenty million dollars, for a young white staff member whose salary he doubled; he never did that for a black woman. Shannon Sharpe lost his place at ESPN. He lost everything for a white coontang. That is a snare and a trap right there. Halle Berry has to pay that Edomite, her ex-partner, eight thousand dollars a month, and when she pays him he says, Thank you, nigger, and walks away. They lost everything for a snare.

We are not where we should be yet, but we are making strides to get there.

“Beware of all whoredom, my son, and chiefly take a wife of the seed of thy fathers, and take not a strange woman to wife, which is not of thy father’s tribe”. Do not take a strange woman.

“For we are the children of the prophets, Noe, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: remember, my son, that our fathers from the beginning, even that they all married wives of their own kindred, and were blessed in their children, and their seed shall inherit the land.” Blessed in their children: a lot of biracial children are confused, and it is rare when they know exactly who and what they are.

sense.text: “Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion”: that is Christ.
“The Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee”: the Son, the “thee”, is Christ.

“Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance”: the Father says to Christ, ask of me, and I will give you the heathen for your inheritance. Christ is going to inherit all these nations (Psalms 82:8). “And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession”: to rule the planet.

“Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.” Christ is going to break them with a rod of iron. And everything Christ was given, he said he would give to us. All we have to do is endure to the end.

“Be wise now therefore, O ye kings”: that is a message to us, a warning, advice, a command. “Be instructed, ye judges of the earth”: Christ is calling us the judges of the earth. We might look like knuckles right now, but give us time. Be patient with us, sisters.

precepts.why: Everything Christ is given, he gives to us, because we are joint heirs with him: “And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ”. That is what a joint heir is: what Christ gets in Psalms 2, he is going to give to us.

Here is the proof: “And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.”

This is what Psalms 2 says Christ is going to get, but because we are joint heirs, we are going to get it too. The same honour and glory the Father gave to Christ, Christ gives to us. All we have to do is endure to the end.
Who are the kings of Psalms 2:10? Christ “hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father”. So “Be wise now therefore, O ye kings” is a warning to us.

sense.text: Paul says the same thing as Psalms 2:10. “Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints?” The law they were going to was the scribes and Pharisees. How dare you go to them? They do not even believe in Christ, and they do not apply the laws correctly. You are supposed to go to the saints.

“Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world?” The saints are the Israelites, and the Israelites will judge this planet. That is your future. “And if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters?” Then why do you not judge the small matters among you?
“Know ye not that we shall judge angels?” The angels we will judge are not Michael, Gabriel or Uriel. They are each other; the angels are Israel. “How much more things that pertain to this life?”

“Set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church”: if the leaders, the higher-ranking officers, act as if they cannot judge and always have an excuse, move them out of the way and get the young men. The young men have the fire, the zeal, the desire and the understanding to do the job.

“I speak to your shame”: I am shaming you senior men, you officers, because you do not want to do your job. “Is it so, that there is not a wise man among you? no, not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren?” You have been studying all these years, and not one wise brother can handle this work? Then get the young one.
“But brother goeth to law with brother, and that before the unbelievers”: going to the scribes and Pharisees.

precepts.why: Somebody will say the saints are everybody who believes on Jesus. Shut up; you do not know what you are talking about: “He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel”. The saints are the Israelites. So when Paul says “the saints shall judge the world”, it is the Israelites who will judge this planet.

The angels we shall judge are Israel: “ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.” We are going to judge each other, the twelve tribes.

sense.text:
“The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the Lord shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory. Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself”. Everything is going back to the way it was.

It does not mean there will be no sun and no moon; they will always be there. But we will not need this light, because we will be on another level, a spiritual level, a God level. “And the days of thy mourning shall be ended.”
“And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven”: that is what Christ meant when he said, Thy kingdom come.
“And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel”.
“And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.” That is what we just read in Isaiah 60:19.

“And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it”: people use this to say all the nations will be saved. Saved here does not mean salvation; it is in the context of rulership. Saved means left: they were left from being destroyed. Christ did not destroy them, because we need slaves, and they are going to obey.

Walking in the light is coming to our light: our light is the laws in Christ, and they will come up to worship the King and keep the feast of tabernacles, the high holy days. “And the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.”

“And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there. And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.” That is what Isaiah 60:11 said: the gates open continually, that men may bring the forces of the Gentiles and their kings.

“And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie”: those nations are not walking in. They bring their glory to us at the front gate, and then they go back. “But they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life”: that is the twelve tribes of Israel.

precepts.why:
What does it mean, the nations which are saved? Saved from what? “And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.”

Saved means left: they were left from being destroyed. Everyone that is left goes up from year to year to worship the King and keep the feast of tabernacles. That is them coming to our light, walking in the light of the city. And “whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.”

God is saying to us, “Arise, shine; for thy light is come”: arise, wake up; shine means teach; thy light is come, Christ is come. “And the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee”: that is the Holy Spirit.

“For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people”: we are in the worst darkness. “But the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee”: wisdom and knowledge shall be seen upon us.

“And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.” That is what “the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it” means: the nations coming to our light, to the laws in Christ, going up to worship the King and keep the feast of tabernacles. They are going to serve.

“Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.”

That is what Revelation 21 is explaining: “the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it”, “the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day”, and “they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.” They bring the wealth of the nations to us at the gate.
